title_en: A career built around people, language, and possibility
title_id: Perjalanan karier yang bertumbuh dari manusia, bahasa, dan peluang
lead_en: Her work sits at the meeting point of language education, social understanding, and community development.
lead_id: Karya beliau berada di pertemuan antara pendidikan bahasa, pemahaman sosial, dan pengembangan komunitas.
story_1_en: Komang Ayu Wisnu Wardani began her academic journey in Sociology at Universitas Gadjah Mada. The discipline taught her to see learning not as an isolated classroom activity, but as something shaped by culture, confidence, opportunity, and human relationships.
story_1_id: Komang Ayu Wisnu Wardani memulai perjalanan akademiknya melalui bidang Sosiologi di Universitas Gadjah Mada. Bidang tersebut membentuk cara pandangnya bahwa proses belajar tidak pernah berdiri sendiri, melainkan dipengaruhi oleh budaya, kepercayaan diri, kesempatan, dan hubungan antarmanusia.
story_2_en: She later pursued a Master of Social Work through the international joint program of UIN Sunan Kalijaga and McGill University. This experience strengthened her interest in education as a form of empowerment and gave her a wider perspective on how knowledge can move across cultures.
story_2_id: Beliau kemudian menempuh Master of Social Work melalui program internasional bersama UIN Sunan Kalijaga dan McGill University. Pengalaman tersebut memperkuat ketertarikannya pada pendidikan sebagai bentuk pemberdayaan sekaligus memperluas pandangannya tentang bagaimana pengetahuan dapat bergerak lintas budaya.
story_3_en: Since joining the Language Development Center of UIN Sunan Kalijaga in 2008, she has worked with students from diverse academic backgrounds. Her classes combine structure with warmth: clear learning goals, communicative practice, digital tools, personal encouragement, and room for learners to make mistakes without losing confidence.
story_3_id: Sejak bergabung dengan Pusat Pengembangan Bahasa UIN Sunan Kalijaga pada 2008, beliau telah mendampingi mahasiswa dari beragam latar akademik. Kelasnya memadukan struktur dan kehangatan: tujuan belajar yang jelas, latihan komunikatif, teknologi pembelajaran, dorongan personal, serta ruang untuk melakukan kesalahan tanpa kehilangan kepercayaan diri.
mcgill_title_en: A formative summer at McGill University
mcgill_title_id: Pengalaman musim panas yang membentuk di McGill University
mcgill_text_en: During the 2005 Interdisciplinary Islamic Studies Summer Course in Montreal, she studied research methodology, developed her thesis proposal, and explored McGill University's library collections. One of her most memorable experiences was exchanging ideas directly with professors and sharing Balinese culture through a farewell dance performance.
mcgill_text_id: Dalam Interdisciplinary Islamic Studies Summer Course 2005 di Montreal, beliau mempelajari metodologi penelitian, mengembangkan proposal tesis, dan menelusuri literatur di perpustakaan McGill University. Salah satu pengalaman yang paling membekas adalah berdiskusi langsung dengan para profesor serta memperkenalkan budaya Bali melalui penampilan tari dalam acara perpisahan.
